description: This file defines a mock class for testing, specifically a mock implementation of the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper interface used in the Rialto server component. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata in GstBuffer objects.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper for unit testing purposes, providing mock methods for protection metadata operations.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Mock method to simulate adding protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve protection metadata data from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Mock method to remove protection metadata from a GstBuffer.
